Day to day

Casework and drafting
- Helping the team run live disputes, working with fee-earners at all levels.

- Preparing chronologies, summaries of key documents, case management reports, costs budgets and statements of costs.
- Carrying out legal and factual research, and helping gather evidence and take witness accounts.

Court and counsel

- Getting cases trial-ready, going to court with the team where needed and drafting orders afterwards.

Disclosure, bundles and case management
- Running disclosure and e-disclosure, from document review through to production.
- Assembling hearing, trial and authorities bundles in hard copy and electronic form.
- Tracking procedural deadlines and directions, and keeping case trackers, disclosure logs and hearing diaries up to date.
- Keeping matter records accurate and in line with internal procedures.

Clients and the wider team
- Liaising with clients, expert witnesses, patent and trade mark attorneys, and third parties.
- Contributing to business development activity.

What you'll need
- Two to three years in a contentious IP paralegal role, with cases you have followed through to trial.
- Solid grounding in CPR procedure, plus hands-on experience drafting, issuing and filing court documents.
- Confidence dealing with the court, barristers' clerks and external counsel.
- Strong Excel skills: building and maintaining trackers, handling large volumes of review data, preparing costs schedules and producing reports. Fluent across the rest of the Microsoft Office suite.
- Comfortable using DMS and e-disclosure platforms.
- Precise, highly organised and able to manage competing deadlines without losing accuracy.
- Clear, professional communication in writing and in person.
- Discretion with confidential and sensitive material.

Nice to have
- A law degree, GDL, LPC, or SQE study underway or completed.
- Exposure to expert evidence or technically complex cases.

The person

You are proactive, solution-focused and comfortable taking ownership of your own work, but equally at home as part of a close team. You have commercial awareness, a genuine interest in IP and ambitions to keep progressing in disputes work.
